scope: Reported-input factors for general-company canonical financial panels; not valuation or owner earnings.
period_policy: annual or single-quarter flows only; exact period_start and period_end match
quarter_policy: reported direct quarters and proved same-filing derived quarters may pair; each input_accessions set must equal its top-level accession
vintage_policy: Latest panel values only; never search older filings to complete a pair

factors.definition_note: Reported operating income divided by the explicitly mapped reported revenue. No cross-company accounting-scope reconciliation.
Parent-attributable net_income only. Do not replace with consolidated or common-shareholder-specific profit.
Reported operating cash flow divided by reported revenue; negative operating cash flow remains negative.

factors.label_zh: 报告研发费用与收入比
factors.definition_note: Reported expensed R&D, excluding separately capitalized software/development. Negative reported expense is excluded for review, not converted to its absolute value.

factors.label_zh: 报告股权激励金额与收入比
factors.definition_note: Reported ShareBasedCompensation, normally a noncash item. This is not a cash-spending share. Negative reversals are excluded for review.

factors.label_zh: PPE购置现金支出与收入比
factors.definition_note: Explicitly mapped PPE purchase cash outflow; not acquisitions, all intangible investment or maintenance capex. Never substitute broader productive_asset_purchases.

Operating cash flow less reported PPE cash purchases. Not owner earnings, maintenance cash flow, all capital investment, or a fully adjusted free-cash-flow measure. Negative PPE payments are excluded; no abs() sign conversion.

factors.label_zh: 较宽生产性资产购置支出与收入比
factors.definition_note: Broader reported productive-asset purchase cash outflow. A separate metric, never a fallback for PPE capex; its exact scope follows the source tag. Not maintenance capex or all economic investment.

factors.label_zh: 较宽生产性资产购置口径自由现金流代理
factors.definition_note: Operating cash flow less broader reported productive-asset purchases. Kept separate from the PPE proxy; not owner earnings, maintenance cash flow, a reconciled all-investment measure or a substitute for missing PPE data.
